/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available

/-- Decidability of `Avail` (§46). -/
instance (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail E region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-! ## `ArenaInv` (§55) -/

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55), required for live arenas. "Still-issued" is read as "with an active block
authority". The clause "anchor and ownership restrictions are respected" has no referent and is
not represented; "complying with exclusivity and validity rules" is left to the kernel
invariants (§57). -/
structure ArenaInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §55, item 1: `storage` designates an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable E.storage
  /-- §55, item 1: the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`. -/
  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp E.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` is active. -/
  active : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` has own mode `Modify` and is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  shape : OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §55, item 3: available leaves belong to the administered storage. -/
  availableIn : ∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 3: issued regions belong to the administered storage. -/
  issuedIn : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 4: two still-active issuances have disjoint regions. -/
  disjoint : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
    ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1
  /-- §55, item 4: no leaf of a still-issued region belongs to `available`. -/
  notAvailable : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available
  /-- §55, item 5: every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal`. -/
  derived : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2

/-- Shape of the issued blocks (support for §55, item 5, from the `ok` effect of §77; not a clause
of `ArenaInv`): every issued block authority exists, has direct origin `internal`, a fresh identity
above it, its region as footprint and mode `Modify`. -/
def IssuedShape (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some E.internal ∧ E.internal < e.2 ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify

/-- The per-entry library invariant (§55): `ArenaInv` and the auxiliary `IssuedShape`. -/
def EntryInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := ArenaInv s E ∧ IssuedShape s E

/-- The library invariant (§55, §46): every registered `internal` exists, and every live entry
satisfies `EntryInv`. -/
def LInv (L : LState) : Prop :=
  ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, E.internal < L.kern.A.length ∧ (Live L.kern E → EntryInv L.kern E)

/-! ## O17 `newArena` (§76) and the guard of §56 -/

/-- All leaves of the place holding an authority are `Init` (§76.5); vacuous for a frame. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

/-- Decidability of `LeavesInit` (§76.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- The unified administration guard (§56, §76.4) as a contract predicate: `internal` is absent
from every registry of live administrations. A registry is given by the `internal` identities of
its live administrations; `regs` lists all relevant registries. -/
def Guard56 (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Prop := ∀ R ∈ regs, i ∉ R

/-- Decidability of `Guard56` (§56). -/
instance (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 regs i) := by
  unfold Guard56; infer_instance

/-- The arena registry as a registry of live administrations (§46, §56): the `internal`
identities of its live entries. -/
def liveInternals (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) : List Nat :=
  (arenas.filter fun E => decide (s.Active E.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` other than the guard (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5).
§76.6 restates invariants and is not a precondition (`newArena_clause6`). -/
structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5. -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)

/-! ## O18 `issue` (§77) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `issue(arena, region, destination)` (§77.1, §77.2). The static
restrictions of §77.3 are given no list by the text and are not represented. -/
structure IssueStatic (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.1: the entry is live; `internal` is active. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §77.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §77.2: `region` belongs to the administered storage. -/
  regionIn : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is a leaf. -/
  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` holds no active authority. -/
  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
  /-- §77.2: `destination` can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §77.2: local self-blocking prevention, `destination` is not in `region`. -/
  dstNotIn : dst ∉ region

/-- Decidability of `IssueStatic` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueStatic s E region dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True) ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ dst ∉ region)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- §77.5: the effective mode of `internal` permits `Modify` on every leaf of the region. -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s E.internal l) .modify

/-- Decidability of `IssueRight` (§77.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s E region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect): a block authority of fresh identity
`|A|`, derived from `internal`, of mode `Modify`, on the region, held by `destination`, which
receives the corresponding anchor; only leaf `destination` becomes `Init`. -/
def issueKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩]
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ [s.A.length] else s.D q
    I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l }

/-- Metadata part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect; §46): the leaves of the region leave
`available`; the issuance joins `issued` with its authority. -/
def issueMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : ArenaEntry :=
  { E with
    available := E.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
    issued := (region, s.A.length) :: E.issued }

/-- Checks of `issue` on the simulated resulting state (§77.3, §77.6). -/
structure IssueArrival (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.3: `AnchorOrder` for the new anchor of `destination`, in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
    ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst)
  /-- §77.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst)
  /-- §77.6, O8.5: `destination` remains under exercisable `Modify` in the resulting state. -/
  keepsDst : HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst

/-- Decidability of `IssueArrival` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueArrival s E region dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
      ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst) ∧
    HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩

/-- Library state after an `ok` issue of entry `i` (§77, `ok` effect). -/
def issueL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : LState :=
  ⟨issueKEff L.kern E region dst, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩

/-- The contract of `issue` on entry `i` (§77, §58): `reject` when the entry is missing or a
static precondition fails; `fail`, the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable (§77.4);
`reject` when the effective right (§77.5) or a check on the resulting state (§77.3, §77.6)
fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive IssueC (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      ¬ Avail E region → IssueC i region dst L .fail
  | noRight {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → ¬ IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | noArrival {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → ¬ IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L (.ok (issueL L i E region dst))

/-- `issue` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §77): its static checks, then the availability
`fail` (§77.4), then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh
identity `|A|`, into the destination (O8); the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
inductive IssueD (k : K) (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      ¬ Avail E region → IssueD k i region dst L .fail
  | split {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern .reject →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | store {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      IssueStatic L.kern E region dst → Avail E region →
      SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩)

/-! ## O19 `reset` (§78) -/

/-- §78.3: no still-usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of
`internal`. Dependencies of contained values are covered since parts are places. -/
def ResetNoDeps (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, E.internal ∉ s.ancs x

/-- Decidability of `ResetNoDeps` (§78.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetNoDeps s E) := by
  unfold ResetNoDeps; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `reset(arena)` (§78). "`internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain
valid" (§78.1) and "validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied" (§78.3) name no
checkable condition beyond `ArenaInv` and are not represented. -/
structure ResetPre (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §78.1: the entry is live. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §78.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §78.2: no active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the storage. -/
  noCover : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §78.3: no usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of `internal`. -/
  noDeps : ResetNoDeps s E

/-- Decidability of `ResetPre` (§78). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetPre s E) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
      ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ ResetNoDeps s E)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, Part XIV): the record of the `Modify`
derivation of `internal` over all the storage, already released; no leaf becomes `Init`. -/
def resetKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint s.P E.storage, .frame s.top, false⟩] }

/-- Metadata part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, §46): all leaves of the storage
become available; `issued` is cleared. -/
def resetMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : ArenaEntry :=
  { E with available := footprint s.P E.storage, issued := [] }

/-- Library state after an `ok` reset of entry `i` (§78). -/
def resetL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) : LState :=
  ⟨resetKEff L.kern E, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩

/-- The contract of `reset` on entry `i` (§78, §58): `ok` when the entry exists and the
preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
inductive ResetC (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetC i L .reject
  | reject {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ ResetPre L.kern E → ResetC i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ResetPre L.kern E →
      ResetC i L (.ok (resetL L i E))

/-- `reset` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §78): `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the
footprint of the storage (O1), `release` of the derived authority (O3), then the explicit contract
check of §78.3; the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
inductive ResetD (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetD i L .reject
  | derive {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern .reject →
      ResetD i L .reject
  | release {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → ResetD i L .reject
  | contract {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ¬ ResetNoDeps L.kern E → ResetD i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ResetNoDeps L.kern E →
      ResetD i L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩)

/-! ## Library runs (Part XIV, §46, §56, §57) -/

/-- One `ok` step of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel step O1–O16 of non-administrative code,
the registry unchanged; `newArena` with the guard of §56 against the other registries `others`;
the derived `issue` or `reset`. -/
inductive LStep (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
  | kernel {L : LState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → LStep k L ⟨s', L.arenas⟩
  | newArena {L L' : LState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
      NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
  | issue {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} :
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
  | reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} : ResetD i L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'

/-- One `ok` step of a library run in which `newArena` registers without the guard of §56
(§76.4 removed, the other preconditions of §76 kept). -/
inductive LStepNG (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
  | kernel {L : LState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → LStepNG k L ⟨s', L.arenas⟩
  | newArena {L : LState} {st i : Nat} : NewArenaBase L.kern st i →
      LStepNG k L (newArenaEff L st i)
  | issue {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} :
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') → LStepNG k L L'
  | reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} : ResetD i L (.ok L') → LStepNG k L L'

/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps (Part
XIV). -/
inductive LReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : LState → Prop where
  | init : LReach k statics (LState.init statics)
  | step {L L' : LState} : LReach k statics L → LStep k L L' → LReach k statics L'

/-- Library states reachable when `newArena` registers without the guard of §56. -/
inductive LReachNG (k : K) (statics : Statics) : LState → Prop where
  | init : LReachNG k statics (LState.init statics)
  | step {L L' : LState} : LReachNG k statics L → LStepNG k L L' → LReachNG k statics L'

/-- Finite sequences of library steps (Part XIV, §46). -/
inductive LRun (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
  | refl (L : LState) : LRun k L L
  | tail {L L' L'' : LState} : LRun k L L' → LStep k L' L'' → LRun k L L''

/-- `newArena` changes no kernel component (Part XIV, §76 `ok` effect: registering the entry
fabricates no place, access right or `Init` state). -/
theorem newArena_kernel {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} {L L' : LState}
    (h : NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L')) : L'.kern = L.kern := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl

/-- A guarded library step is a step without the guard (§56). -/
theorem LStep.ng {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') : LStepNG k L L' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact .kernel hk
  | newArena hs => obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact .newArena hp.base
  | issue hs => exact .issue hs
  | reset hs => exact .reset hs

/-- Every library-reachable state is reachable without the guard (§56). -/
theorem LReach.ng {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : LState} (h : LReach k statics L) :
    LReachNG k statics L := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact .step ih hs.ng

/-- The kernel part of a library step without the guard is reached by kernel steps (Part XIV,
§57: `newArena` changes no kernel component, `issue` is `split` then `store`, `reset` is `derive`
then `release`). -/
theorem LStepNG.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L L' : LState}
    (hr : Reachable k statics L.kern) (h : LStepNG k L L') : Reachable k statics L'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
  | newArena _ => exact hr
  | issue hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
  | reset hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hd hrl _ => exact .step (.step hr (.derive hd)) (.release hrl)

/-- The kernel state of every library state reachable without the guard is kernel-reachable
(§57, Part XIV). -/
theorem LReachNG.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : LState}
    (h : LReachNG k statics L) : Reachable k statics L.kern := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih

/-- `newArena_as_library` (Part XIV, §56, §57): registration changes no kernel component, and no
safety property of §57 depends on the guard of §56: every property of kernel-reachable states holds
for the kernel states of library runs with or without the guard. -/
theorem newArena_as_library (k : K) (statics : Statics) :
    (∀ (others : List (List Nat)) (st i : Nat) (L L' : LState),
      NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') → L'.kern = L.kern) ∧
    (∀ L, LReach k statics L → LReachNG k statics L) ∧
    ∀ Q : S3 → Prop, (∀ s, Reachable k statics s → Q s) →
      ∀ L, LReachNG k statics L → Q L.kern :=
  ⟨fun _ _ _ _ _ h => newArena_kernel h, fun _ h => h.ng, fun _ hQ _ h => hQ _ h.reachable⟩

Runs from `LState.init Examples.st` (§47: static leaves 0 `Init`, 1 and 2 `Uninit`, with root
authorities 0, 1 and 2 held by frame 0) under the test contract `Examples.K0`. Leaf 0 is the arena
value, leaf 1 the storage, leaf 2 the destination. Every precondition is decided by `decide`;
`KInv ∧ KAux` of the final states is decided through `KInvB`. -/

namespace Witness

open Examples

/-- Initial library state (§47). -/
def w0 : LState := LState.init st
/-- `derive(1, [1], Modify)`: authority 3 on the storage leaf, held by frame 0 (§60). -/
def w1 : LState := ⟨deriveEff w0.kern 1 [1] .modify, w0.arenas⟩
/-- `store(3, 0)`: authority 3 becomes `internal`, held by the arena value 0 (§65). -/
def w2 : LState := ⟨storeEff w1.kern 3 0, w1.arenas⟩
/-- `newArena(1, 3)` (§76). -/
def w3 : LState := newArenaEff w2 1 3
/-- The entry registered by `newArena(1, 3)` (§46, §76). -/
def wE : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [1], []⟩

/-- The common prefix is library-reachable (Part XIV, §76). -/
theorem w3_reach : LReach K0 st w3 := by
  have r1 : LReach K0 st w1 := .step .init (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
  have r2 : LReach K0 st w2 := .step r1 (.kernel (.store (.ok (by decide))))
  exact .step r2 (.newArena (others := []) (.ok (by decide)))

/-- `issue(0, [], 2)`: `split(3, [[]])` then `store(4, 2)`; block 4 is active, of empty
footprint, anchored on the usable destination 2 (§77). -/
def c4 : LState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff w3.kern 3 [[]]) w3.kern.A.length 2, w3.arenas.set 0 (issueMeta w3.kern wE [])⟩

/-- The entry after the issue of the empty region (§77 `ok` effect). -/
def cE : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [1], [([], 4)]⟩

/-- **§78.3 is not implied by §78.2 and I3** (spec problem). In a library-reachable state
satisfying `KInv ∧ KAux`, after issuing the empty region (the empty region is always available,
§46, §77.4), the live entry satisfies §78.1 and §78.2 and I3 holds, yet §78.3 fails: the usable
destination 2 depends on the active empty block 4, in the strict origin subtree of `internal` 3.
The contract of `reset` rejects, while `derive` of `internal` over the storage and `release` are
`ok`: §78.3 stays an explicit contract check (`reset_as_kernel`). The sentence of §78.3 "Under
precondition 2 and invariant I3, this condition follows from the absence of active descendants
covering the storage" is false. -/
theorem reset_clause3_not_implied :
    LReach K0 st c4 ∧ KInv c4.kern ∧ KAux c4.kern ∧ c4.arenas[0]? = some cE ∧
    Live c4.kern cE ∧ MetaRight c4.kern cE ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range c4.kern.A.length, cE.internal ∈ c4.kern.ancs j → c4.kern.Active j →
      ∀ l ∈ c4.kern.afp j, l ∉ footprint c4.kern.P cE.storage) ∧ I3 c4.kern ∧
    ¬ ResetNoDeps c4.kern cE ∧
    c4.kern.Active 4 ∧ c4.kern.afp 4 = [] ∧ 4 ∈ c4.kern.D 2 ∧ c4.kern.Usable 2 ∧
    cE.internal ∈ c4.kern.ancs 4 ∧ ResetC 0 c4 .reject ∧
    DeriveStep cE.internal (footprint c4.kern.P cE.storage) .modify c4.kern
      (.ok (deriveEff c4.kern cE.internal (footprint c4.kern.P cE.storage) .modify)) ∧
    ReleaseStep c4.kern.A.length
      (deriveEff c4.kern cE.internal (footprint c4.kern.P cE.storage) .modify)
      (.ok (releaseEff (deriveEff c4.kern cE.internal (footprint c4.kern.P cE.storage) .modify)
        c4.kern.A.length)) := by
  have hr : LReach K0 st c4 := .step w3_reach
    (.issue (i := 0) (region := []) (dst := 2)
      (.ok (E := wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
  have hk := KInvB.sound (s := c4.kern) (by decide)
  have hE : c4.arenas[0]? = some cE := by decide
  have hn : ¬ ResetNoDeps c4.kern cE := by decide
  exact ⟨hr, hk.1, hk.2, hE, by decide, by decide, by decide, hk.1.2.1.1.2.2.1, hn, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, .reject hE fun h => hn h.noDeps, .ok (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- `issue(0, [1], 2)`: `split(3, [[1]])` then `store(4, 2)` (§77). -/
def r4 : LState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff w3.kern 3 [[1]]) w3.kern.A.length 2,
    w3.arenas.set 0 (issueMeta w3.kern wE [1])⟩
/-- `write(4, [1])`: the storage leaf 1 is written through block 4 (§67). -/
def r5 : LState := ⟨write3Eff r4.kern [1], r4.arenas⟩
/-- `endUse(2)`: the destination ends; block 4, held by it, is released (§69). -/
def r6 : LState := ⟨endUseEff r5.kern 2, r5.arenas⟩
/-- The entry after the first issue (§77 `ok` effect). -/
def rE : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [], [([1], 4)]⟩
/-- `reset(0)`: `derive(3, [1], Modify)`, `release(5)`, metadata restored (§78). -/
def r7 : LState :=
  ⟨releaseEff (deriveEff r6.kern 3 (footprint r6.kern.P 1) .modify) r6.kern.A.length,
    r6.arenas.set 0 (resetMeta r6.kern rE)⟩
/-- The entry after the reset (§78 `ok` effect). -/
def rE' : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [1], []⟩
/-- `issue(0, [1], 2)` again: `split(3, [[1]])` then `store(6, 2)` (§77). -/
def r8 : LState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff r7.kern 3 [[1]]) r7.kern.A.length 2,
    r7.arenas.set 0 (issueMeta r7.kern rE' [1])⟩

/-- **§86: a reissued block reads a former value** (spec problem). Leaf 1 is `Uninit` when it is
first issued, is written through block 4, keeps `Init` across `endUse` of the destination, the
legal `reset` (§78: "No leaf is made `Init` by `reset`", and no leaf is made `Uninit` either) and
the reissue, which initializes only the destination 2 (§77). In the final library-reachable state,
which satisfies `KInv ∧ KAux`, `read` of leaf 1 through the new block 6 is `ok` (§66.1 asks only
that the leaf be `Init`): the reissued block reads the value written under the former issuance,
with no initialization of it after the reissue. This contradicts §86, "Reissuance does not permit
reading a former logical value without the required initialization". -/
theorem reissue_reads_former_value :
    LReach K0 st r8 ∧ KInv r8.kern ∧ KAux r8.kern ∧
    r4.kern.I 1 = .uninit ∧ r5.kern.I 1 = .init ∧ r7.kern.I 1 = .init ∧ r8.kern.I 1 = .init ∧
    ¬ r8.kern.Active 4 ∧
    (r8.kern.A[6]?).map (fun y => (y.origin, y.footprint, y.holder, y.active)) =
      some (some 3, [1], .place 2, true) ∧
    r8.arenas = [⟨1, 3, [], [([1], 6)]⟩] ∧
    Read3Step 6 [1] r8.kern (.ok r8.kern) := by
  have h4 : LReach K0 st r4 := .step w3_reach
    (.issue (i := 0) (region := [1]) (dst := 2)
      (.ok (E := wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
  have h5 : LReach K0 st r5 := .step h4 (.kernel (.write (a := 4) (.ok (by decide))))
  have h6 : LReach K0 st r6 := .step h5 (.kernel (.endUse (.ok (by decide))))
  have h7 : LReach K0 st r7 := .step h6
    (.reset (i := 0) (.ok (E := rE) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide)))
  have h8 : LReach K0 st r8 := .step h7
    (.issue (i := 0) (region := [1]) (dst := 2)
      (.ok (E := rE') (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
  have hk := KInvB.sound (s := r8.kern) (by decide)
  exact ⟨h8, hk.1, hk.2, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

end Witness

end Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

import Ern.HandlePool

/-!
# MM3-H: adversarial corpus of the access discipline (jalon 3, step 2)

The cases of the jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2), §1 sections A to I, and the usage
scenarios W1 to W3 of §5b. Each case is a run from the initial state `S3.init statics`
(MM-03.3.9) by `ok` steps of the extended machine (`Ern.HandlePool.PReach`), checked by `prun`;
the verdict of the step under test is stated with the relation of its operation (MM-03.3 §3–6,
material §4) and decided on the reached state. The expected verdict comes from the source named in
the material, never from the module (material §0, rule 1). Every rejection has a twin: the same
run without the faulty element, where the same step is accepted (rule 2). The class (rule 5) is in
each docstring; the jalon-3 report, (a), gathers expected and obtained verdicts. Section J is not
encoded (report, (a)); `J_H42_expansion` keeps the one straight-line expansion that the kernel can
run.

Local shapes are lists of (parent, owning local, kind), as for `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6);
`lf` is a root leaf.
-/

namespace Ern.MM03.Horrors

open Ern.MM03 Ern.HandlePool

/-- The state given for a run whose steps are not all `ok`: it has no frame, so no run reaches it
(`run_ok_of_reach`). -/
def stuckPS : PS := ⟨{ S3.init [] with F := [] }, [], 0, []⟩

section Run
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- The state reached by the operations `os` from `S3.init statics`; `stuckPS` when a step is not
`ok`. So a statement `PReach k statics (run k statics os)` says that every step is `ok`
(`run_ok_of_reach`). -/
def run (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : PS :=
  (prun k (PS.init statics) os).getD stuckPS

end Run

section RunSound
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A run whose steps are all `ok` reaches its final state (material §0, rule 3). -/
theorem run_reach {statics : Statics} {os : List Op} (hsh : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)))
    (h : (prun k (PS.init statics) os).isSome = true) : PReach k statics (run k statics os) :=
  prun_init hsh (some_getD h)

/-- Under `DDSound`, a reached `run` is a run whose every step is `ok`: the state given for a failed
run has no frame, which `WF3` excludes on reached states (MM-03.3 §2.1). -/
theorem run_ok_of_reach (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {os : List Op}
    (h : PReach k statics (run k statics os)) : (prun k (PS.init statics) os).isSome = true := by
  cases hp : prun k (PS.init statics) os with
  | some _ => rfl
  | none =>
    have hr := pReach_reachable hdd h
    simp only [run, hp, Option.getD_none] at hr
    exact absurd rfl (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1.2.2.1

end RunSound

/-- A read rejected for every authority of the state is rejected for every authority (MM-03.3 §5,
`canRead3`: the reading authority exists). -/
theorem read_rejected {s : S3} {ls : List Nat} (h : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ canRead3 s a ls)
    (a : Nat) : Read3Step a ls s .reject :=
  .reject fun hc => by
    by_cases ha : a < s.A.length
    · exact h a (List.mem_range.2 ha) hc
    · cases hc.1 with
      | base hy => exact ha (lt_of_getElem? hy)
      | held hy => exact ha (lt_of_getElem? hy)

/-- A write rejected for every authority of the state is rejected for every authority (MM-03.3 §5,
`canWrite3`). -/
theorem write_rejected {s : S3} {ls : List Nat} (h : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ canWrite3 s a ls)
    (a : Nat) : Write3Step a ls s .reject :=
  .reject fun hc => by
    by_cases ha : a < s.A.length
    · exact h a (List.mem_range.2 ha) hc
    · cases hc.1 with
      | base hy => exact ha (lt_of_getElem? hy)
      | held hy => exact ha (lt_of_getElem? hy)

/-- A root leaf of a shape. -/
abbrev lf : Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat := (none, none, 0)

/-- A structure 0 with the parts 1 and 2. -/
def S2 : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) := [lf, (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0)]

/-! ## A. Exclusivity and indirect aliasing -/

/-- H01, structure and first parameter: frame 1, structure 0 with the parts 1 and 2, root 0; the
frame derives 1, `Modify` on 0. -/
def h01 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 0 .modify]
/-- Twin of H01: the same frame without the first parameter. -/
def h01t : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] S2]

/-- **H01** (A; I1, A3, G1; class N3). Two parameters derived from the same local, `Modify` on the
whole then `Observe` on a part: the second `derive` from the root is rejected, the root having no
effective mode on the part (MM-03.3.5; O1.3). Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twin without the
first parameter: the same `derive` is accepted, and the call with the first parameter alone is
accepted. -/
theorem H01 : PReach K0 [] h01 ∧ DeriveStep 0 1 .observe h01.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] h01t ∧
    DeriveStep 0 1 .observe h01t.s (.ok (deriveEff h01t.s 0 1 .observe)) ∧
    EnterStep [1] [] h01.s (.ok (enterEff h01.s [1] [])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H01, reading where the `Observe` parameter is derived from the `Modify` one (report, (b)): the
only construction that reaches `enterFrame` with both parameters. Expected (H01 row): reject;
obtained: the call is accepted. G1 constrains the direct origin of a `Modify` parameter only (O6.3),
and the two authorities are related by derivation (I1). -/
theorem H01_reborrow : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 0 .modify,
    .derive 1 1 .observe, .enter [1, 2] []]) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- H02, frame 1 with the structure of H01 and an `Observe` authority 1 on the whole. -/
def h02 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 0 .observe]

/-- **H02** (A; I1, effective mode; N3). `Observe` on the whole, then `Modify` on a part: rejected,
the effective mode of the root on the part being `Observe` (MM-03.3.5). Expected: reject; obtained:
reject. Twin without the observation: accepted. -/
theorem H02 : PReach K0 [] h02 ∧ DeriveStep 0 1 .modify h02.s .reject ∧
    DeriveStep 0 1 .modify h01t.s (.ok (deriveEff h01t.s 0 1 .modify)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H03: frame 1, structure X (0) with the parts `p` (1) and 2, leaf Y (3); the frame derives 2,
`Modify` on `p`, and stores it into Y. -/
def h03o : List Op := [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf]), .derive 0 1 .modify, .store 2 3]
def h03 : PS := run K0 [] h03o
def h03t : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf])]

/-- **H03** (A; I1, F4; N3). The value of Y holds a `Modify` derived on the part `p` of X; a write
of `p` through the root of X is rejected (no effective mode, MM-03.3.5; O10). Expected: reject;
obtained: reject. Twin without the stored authority: accepted. The `store` is not what makes the
write fail: after the `derive` alone, the write is already rejected (I1, effective mode), so the case
does not exercise F4 itself. -/
theorem H03 : PReach K0 [] h03 ∧ Write3Step 0 [1] h03.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] h03t ∧
    Write3Step 0 [1] h03t.s (.ok (write3Eff h03t.s [1])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H04: frame 1, array 0 with the elements 1 and 2, and an authority 1, `Modify` on element 1. -/
def h04 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 1 .modify]

/-- **H04** (A; O2, I1; N3). Swap of two elements: by `split` of the array, two writes, all `ok`;
by two `derive Modify` of the same element, the second is rejected. Expected: `ok` / reject;
obtained: `ok` / reject. Twin of the rejection: `derive Modify` of the other element, accepted. -/
theorem H04 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .split 0 [[1], [2]], .write 1 [1],
      .write 2 [2]]) ∧
    PReach K0 [] h04 ∧ DeriveStep 0 1 .modify h04.s .reject ∧
    DeriveStep 0 2 .modify h04.s (.ok (deriveEff h04.s 0 2 .modify)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H05: frame 1, structure `x` (0) with the fields `f` (1) and 2, leaf `tmp` (3); `x` written. -/
def h05 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf]), .write 0 [1, 2]]

/-- **H05** (A; F5, J1; N3; covered pass 6). `transfer(x, x.f)` is rejected (destination `Init`,
footprints overlapping). Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twin: `transfer(x.f, tmp)` then
`transfer(tmp, x.f)`, the destination `Moved` and of the same shape: accepted. -/
theorem H05 : PReach K0 [] h05 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 1 h05.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf]), .write 0 [1, 2], .transfer 1 3,
      .transfer 3 1]) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- **H06** (A; O3, effective mode; N3). `derive Modify`, `derive Observe` below it, `release` of
both, then a write through the root: every step `ok`. Expected: `ok`; obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H06 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .derive 0 0 .modify, .derive 1 0 .observe,
    .release 2, .release 1, .write 0 [0]]) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-! ## B. Lifetime and escape -/

/-- One static leaf, `Uninit`. -/
def stS : Statics := [((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- H07: the base frame derives 1, `Modify` on the static 0, and calls frame 1 with it; frame 1 has
the local `L` (1), written, derives 3, `Observe` on `L`, and calls frame 2 with `[1, 3]`; frame 2
writes its local `W` (2). -/
def h07p : List Op := [.derive 0 0 .modify, .enter [1] [lf], .write 2 [1], .derive 2 1 .observe,
  .enter [1, 3] [lf], .write 4 [2]]
/-- H07: `W` depends on the authority 3, anchored on the caller's local `L`. -/
def h07 : PS := run K0 stS (h07p ++ [.depend 2 3])
def h07t : PS := run K0 stS h07p

/-- **H07** (B; C1, G4; N3). The callee stores into the static, through its `Modify` parameter on
it, a value anchored on a local of the caller: the `transfer` is rejected, the effective anchor
being of frame 1, not an ancestor of the frame 0 of the static (C1, `EffAnchorOK`). Expected: reject
at the `transfer`; obtained: reject. Twin without the anchor: accepted. The stored value is a local
of the callee, which the material leaves open. -/
theorem H07 : PReach K0 stS h07 ∧ TransferStep K0 2 0 h07.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 stS h07t ∧
    TransferStep K0 2 0 h07t.s (.ok (transferEff h07t.s 2 0)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H08/H09: frame 1 with `X` (0), written, and the result `R` (1); it derives 2, `Modify` on `X`,
and 3, `Modify` on `R`, and calls frame 2 with them; frame 2 has `W` (2) and `Lc` (3). -/
def h89 : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .derive 0 0 .modify, .derive 1 1 .modify,
  .enter [2, 3] [lf, lf]]

/-- **H08** (B; C1; N3; covered pass 2). A return anchored on a derivation (7) of a derivation (6)
of the parameter 2: the `transfer` of `W` into `R` and the exit are accepted. Expected: `ok`;
obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H08 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (h89 ++ [.derive 2 0 .observe, .derive 6 0 .observe,
    .write 4 [2], .depend 2 7, .transfer 2 1, .exit])) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- H09: `W` depends on 7, derived from 6, derived from the root of the callee's local `Lc`. -/
def h09 : PS := run K0 [] (h89 ++ [.derive 5 3 .observe, .derive 6 3 .observe, .write 4 [2],
  .depend 2 7])
def h09t : PS := run K0 [] (h89 ++ [.derive 5 3 .observe, .derive 6 3 .observe, .write 4 [2]])

/-- **H09** (B; C1; N3; covered pass 2). A return anchored on a local of the callee through two
derivations: the `transfer` into `R` is rejected (C1). Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twin
without the anchor: accepted. -/
theorem H09 : PReach K0 [] h09 ∧ TransferStep K0 2 1 h09.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] h09t ∧
    TransferStep K0 2 1 h09t.s (.ok (transferEff h09t.s 2 1)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H10: frame 1, `X` (0), the container `C` (1) with the parts 2 and 3, `T` (4); `A` (3) is
`Observe` on `X`, 4 is derived from `A` and stored into the part 2; `C` depends on `A`. -/
def h10p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, (some 1, none, 0), (some 1, none, 0), lf], .write 0 [0],
  .derive 0 0 .observe, .derive 3 0 .observe, .store 4 2, .depend 1 3, .write 1 [3]]
/-- H10 after the transfer of the part 2 into `T` and the end of the container. -/
def h10 : PS := run K0 [] (h10p ++ [.transfer 2 4, .endUse 1])

/-- **H10** (B; §1.6, B10; N3). The part holding an access derived from the anchor `A` of its
container is transferred, the container ends, then `release` of `A` is rejected: the transferred
access is an active descendant (O3.2). Expected: reject at the end of `A`; obtained: reject. Twin
without the transfer of the part: the access dies with the container, and `A` is released. -/
theorem H10 : PReach K0 [] h10 ∧ ReleaseStep 3 h10.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (h10p ++ [.endUse 1, .release 3])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- H11: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, values `v1` (2) and `v2` (3); storage 4 with the
leaves 5 and 6, owned by 0, `internal` 4; blocks 5 on `[5]` to `v1` and 6 on `[6]` to `v2`; `v1`
is transferred into the leaf 6 of the block of `v2`. -/
def h11p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)], .write 0 [0], .newArena 4 4,
  .issue 0 0 [5] 2, .issue 0 0 [6] 3, .transfer 2 6]
def h11 : PS := run K0 [] h11p

/-- **H11** (B; usage, A10; Lib). An arena buffer stored into another block of the same arena: the
`transfer` is accepted, `reset` is rejected while a block lives. Expected: `transfer` `ok`, `reset`
reject; obtained: the same. Twin: after the end of both blocks (`endUse` of `v2`, then of the leaf
6), `reset` is accepted. -/
theorem H11 : PReach K0 [] h11 ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 h11.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (h11p ++ [.endUse 3, .endUse 6, .reset 0 0])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- H12: frame 1, `X` (0) and `W` (2) written, `H` (1); 3, `Observe` on `X`, stored into `H`. -/
def h12p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 2 [2], .derive 0 0 .observe,
  .store 3 1]
def h12 : PS := run K0 [] (h12p ++ [.depend 2 3])

/-- **H12** (B; I3, A6; N3; covered pass 2). `endUse` of the holder `H` of an anchor while `W`
depends on it: rejected (`EndUseAnchorOK`). Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twin without the
dependent: accepted. -/
theorem H12 : PReach K0 [] h12 ∧ EndUseStep K0 1 h12.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (h12p ++ [.endUse 1])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-! ## C. Ownership and release -/

/-- H13: frame 1, allocator 0, `x` (1) and `z` (2) written; `y` (3) allocated, owned by `x`. -/
def h13 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf]]

/-- **H13** (C; A5, `Usable`; N3). An ownership cycle: `y`, owned by `x`, receives `x` by
transfer; rejected, the destination would own itself and stop being usable. Expected: reject;
obtained: reject. Twin: the transfer of `x` into `z` is accepted. -/
theorem H13 : PReach K0 [] h13 ∧ TransferStep K0 1 3 h13.s .reject ∧
    ¬ (transferEff h13.s 1 3).Usable 3 ∧ TransferStep K0 1 2 h13.s (.ok (transferEff h13.s 1 2)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- Contracts with the place 2 deallocable by the authority 7. -/
abbrev KF2 : K := KT [] [] [] [2] [(2, 7)]

/-- H14/H15: frame 1, allocator 0 and `x` (1) written; storage 2 allocated, owned by `x`. -/
def h14p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf]]
def h14 : PS := run KF2 [] (h14p ++ [.free 2 7])

/-- **H14** (C; A6; N3). `free` twice: the second is rejected (the place is dead). Expected: second
reject; obtained: reject. Twin: the first `free` alone is accepted. -/
theorem H14 : PReach KF2 [] h14 ∧ FreeStep KF2 2 7 h14.s .reject :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide)⟩

/-- H15: storage 3 allocated with owner the storage 2; 4, `Observe` on 3, held by the frame. -/
def h15 : PS := run KF2 [] (h14p ++ [.alloc 0 2 [lf], .derive 3 3 .observe])

/-- **H15** (C; O3.2, A6; N3; covered pass 2). `free` of a storage whose owned sub-storage is the
origin of an access held elsewhere: rejected (`FreeAccessOK`). Expected: reject; obtained: reject.
Twin without the access: accepted. -/
theorem H15 : PReach KF2 [] h15 ∧ FreeStep KF2 2 7 h15.s .reject ∧
    PReach KF2 [] (run KF2 [] (h14p ++ [.alloc 0 2 [lf], .free 2 7])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- A `transfer` is rejected while an active derived authority held by a frame covers a leaf of the
source (MM-03.3 §3, O4.4, `ActiveDerivedOutside`): a callee cannot transfer out of the footprint of
one of its parameters (H16). -/
theorem transfer_rejected_by_frame_held {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst j f : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[j]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (ho : y.origin ≠ none)
    (hh : y.holder = .frame f) (hl : ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) :
    TransferStep k src dst s .reject := by
  have had : ActiveDerivedOutside s src j := by
    unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; rw [hy]; exact ⟨ha, ho, by rw [hh]; exact id, hl⟩
  exact .reject fun hpre =>
    hpre.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) had

/-- Contracts with the place 3 deallocable by the authority 7. -/
abbrev KF3 : K := KT [] [] [] [3] [(3, 7)]

/-- H16: frame 1, allocator 0, `x` (1) written, result `R` (2); storage 3 owned by `x`, written; the
caller derives 4, `Modify` on `x`, and 5, `Modify` on `R`, and calls frame 2, with the local 4. -/
def h16p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf],
  .write 3 [3], .derive 1 1 .modify, .derive 2 2 .modify, .enter [4, 5] [lf]]
def h16a : PS := run KF3 [] h16p
/-- H16 as it can run: the callee frees the storage through its parameter on `x`, then returns. -/
def h16 : PS := run KF3 [] (h16p ++ [.free 3 7, .exit])
/-- Twin of H16: the callee returns without freeing. -/
def h16t : PS := run KF3 [] (h16p ++ [.exit])

/-- **H16** (C; A5, A6; N3). The callee receives by transfer a value owning a storage, frees it,
returns the value; the caller reads that storage. Expected: `ok`, then reject. Obtained (report,
(b)): the reception is rejected, a parameter being an active derived authority on the source held
outside it (O4.4, `ActiveDerivedOutside`), so the callee cannot take a value of the caller. With
the free made through the parameter on `x`, the callee's steps are `ok` and the caller's read of the
storage is rejected for every authority. Twin without the `free`: the read is accepted. -/
theorem H16 : PReach KF3 [] h16a ∧ TransferStep KF3 1 4 h16a.s .reject ∧
    ActiveDerivedOutside h16a.s 1 4 ∧ PReach KF3 [] h16 ∧ (∀ a, Read3Step a [3] h16.s .reject) ∧
    PReach KF3 [] h16t ∧ Read3Step 3 [3] h16t.s (.ok h16t.s) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), by decide,
    run_reach (by decide) (by decide), read_rejected (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- Contracts with the place 4 deallocable by the authority 7. -/
abbrev KF4 : K := KT [] [] [] [4] [(4, 7)]

/-- H17: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, 2 and 3; storage 4 with the leaves 5 and 6, owned by
0; `newArena 4 4`. -/
def h17p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)], .write 0 [0], .newArena 4 4]
def h17 : PS := run KF4 [] (h17p ++ [.issue 0 0 [5] 2])
/-- Twin of H17: the same run, the block ended with its value 2. -/
def h17t : PS := run KF4 [] (h17p ++ [.issue 0 0 [5] 2, .endUse 2])
/-- Contracts declaring deallocable, with the authority 7, both the storage 4 and the region 5. -/
abbrev KF45 : K := KT [] [] [] [4, 5] [(4, 7), (5, 7)]
def h17d : PS := run KF45 [] (h17p ++ [.issue 0 0 [5] 2])

/-- **H17** (C; A6, `Deallocable`; Lib; covered pass 2). `free` of the block on `[5]`: rejected,
the region is a part of the storage, not an owned root, nor deallocable under `KF4`; with the region
declared deallocable (`KF45`), the `free` is still rejected (`OwnedRoot`). Expected: reject;
obtained: reject. Twin: in the same run, the block ended, the `free` of the allocated storage 4 is
accepted. -/
theorem H17 : PReach KF4 [] h17 ∧ FreeStep KF4 5 7 h17.s .reject ∧
    PReach KF45 [] h17d ∧ ¬ OwnedRoot h17d.s 5 ∧ FreeStep KF45 5 7 h17d.s .reject ∧
    PReach KF4 [] h17t ∧ FreeStep KF4 4 7 h17t.s (.ok (freeEff h17t.s 4)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    by decide, .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-! ## D. Arenas -/

/-- H18: the arena of H17 under `K0`, the block on `[5]` issued to 2. -/
def h18 : PS := run K0 [] (h17p ++ [.issue 0 0 [5] 2])

/-- **H18** (D; A5; Lib). The arena value transferred into a block of its own storage: rejected,
the storage would be owned by one of its parts. Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twin: the
transfer of the arena value into the local leaf 3 is accepted. -/
theorem H18 : PReach K0 [] h18 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 5 h18.s .reject ∧
    ¬ (transferEff h18.s 0 5).Usable 5 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 3 h18.s (.ok (transferEff h18.s 0 3)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H19: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, values 2 and 3; storage 4 with the leaf 5; parent
arena on 4; block 5 on `[5]` issued to 2; child arena on the leaf 5 with `internal` the block 5. -/
def h19p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1], .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 4, none, 0)],
  .write 0 [0], .newArena 4 4, .issue 0 0 [5] 2, .newArena 5 5]
def h19 : PS := run K0 [] h19p

/-- **H19** (D; F1; Lib; covered pass 6). `reset` of the parent while the child lives: rejected;
after `endUse` of the child value 2: accepted. Expected: reject, then `ok`; obtained: the same. -/
theorem H19 : PReach K0 [] h19 ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 h19.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (h19p ++ [.endUse 2, .reset 0 0])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- **H20** (D; A10, `arena_reuse_safe`; Lib). `alloc`, `newArena`, `issue`, `endUse`, `reset`, then
`issue` of the same region: every step `ok`. Expected: `ok`; obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H20 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],
    .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 3, none, 0)], .write 0 [0], .newArena 3 3, .issue 0 0 [4] 2, .endUse 2,
    .reset 0 0, .issue 0 0 [4] 2]) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- **H21** (D; case 16; Lib; covered pass 5). The arena of case 16, with a `SharedMutable` arena
value 0 (`KA`): frame 1 passes 4, `Observe` on the arena value, and 5, `Modify` on its buffer 2;
the callee issues `[4]` to its local 6 through `writeShared` on the metadata, transfers 6 to 2 and
exits. Expected: `ok`; obtained: `ok` at each step. -/
theorem H21 : PReach KA [] (run KA [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],
    .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 3, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0)], .write 0 [0], .newArena 3 3,
    .derive 0 0 .observe, .derive 2 2 .modify, .enter [4, 5] [lf], .issue 0 4 [4] 6,
    .transfer 6 2, .exit]) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- H21b: frame 1, result 0, derives 1, `Modify` on it, and calls frame 2 with the arena value 1 and
the local buffer 2 with the parts 3 and 4; the callee derives 4, `Modify` on the buffer, stores it
into the arena value, and creates the arena. -/
def h21b : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .derive 0 0 .modify,
  .enter [1] [lf, lf, (some 2, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0)], .derive 3 2 .modify, .store 4 1,
  .newArena 2 4]

/-- **H21b** (D; F2, G4; Lib; covered passes 6 and 7). An arena on a local buffer, transferred to
the caller: rejected at the `transfer` by `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state (G4). Expected:
reject; obtained: reject. Twin: H37, the arena on an allocated storage owned by its value. -/
theorem H21b : PReach K0 [] h21b ∧ TransferStep K0 1 0 h21b.s .reject ∧
    ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff h21b.s 1 0) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), by decide⟩

/-! ## E. Pinning and static storage -/

/-- H22: frame 1, `x` (0) written and pinned, `y` (1). -/
def h22 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .pin 0]
def h22t : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0]]

/-- **H22** (E; A8; N3; covered pass 2). The transfer of a value whose in-place leaf is pinned is
rejected; the transfer of a value whose owned storage only is pinned is accepted. Expected:
reject / `ok`; obtained: the same. Twin of the rejection: without the pin, accepted. -/
theorem H22 : PReach K0 [] h22 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 1 h22.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] h22t ∧
    TransferStep K0 0 1 h22t.s (.ok (transferEff h22t.s 0 1)) ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf],
      .pin 3, .transfer 1 2]) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- H23: frame 1 calls frame 2 with the local 1, pinned. -/
def h23 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .enter [] [lf], .pin 1]

/-- **H23** (E; B4; N3; covered pass 3). Exit of a frame whose local is pinned: rejected. Expected:
reject; obtained: reject. Twin without the pin: accepted. -/
theorem H23 : PReach K0 [] h23 ∧ ExitStep K0 h23.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .enter [] [lf], .exit]) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- Statics: the MMIO leaf 0, `Init`, and the leaf 1. -/
def stM : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false)]
/-- Contracts with the static leaf 0 pinned. -/
abbrev KM : K := KT [] [0] [] [] []

/-- **H24** (E; C5, D1; N3; covered pass 5). A static MMIO region, pinned by `K.Pinned` (and
directly owned by the base frame, `StaticPinnedBottom`): `transfer` and `endUse` rejected.
Expected: reject, reject; obtained: the same. Twin with a static not pinned: both accepted. -/
theorem H24 : PReach KM stM (PS.init stM) ∧ StaticPinnedBottom KM (PS.init stM).s ∧
    TransferStep KM 0 1 (PS.init stM).s .reject ∧ EndUseStep KM 0 (PS.init stM).s .reject ∧
    TransferStep K0 0 1 (PS.init stM).s (.ok (transferEff (PS.init stM).s 0 1)) ∧
    EndUseStep K0 0 (PS.init stM).s (.ok (endUseEff (PS.init stM).s 0)) :=
  ⟨.init (by decide), fun l hl => by
    obtain rfl : l = 0 := List.mem_singleton.1 hl
    exact ⟨0, ⟨none, .frame 0, 0⟩, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩,
    .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- One static leaf, `Init`. -/
def stW : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true)]
def h25 : PS := run K0 stW [.enter [] []]
def h25t : PS := run K0 stW [.derive 0 0 .modify, .enter [1] []]

/-- **H25** (E; A2, D1; N3; covered pass 5). A static written by a callee without parameter:
rejected for every authority (the root is held by the base frame). Expected: reject; obtained:
reject. Twin with a `Modify` parameter on the static: accepted. -/
theorem H25 : PReach K0 stW h25 ∧ (∀ a, Write3Step a [0] h25.s .reject) ∧ PReach K0 stW h25t ∧
    Write3Step 1 [0] h25t.s (.ok (write3Eff h25t.s [0])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), write_rejected (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- Contracts with the place 2 deallocable by 7; the same with `ExternalDone` on 2. -/
abbrev KP : K := KT [] [] [] [2] [(2, 7)]
abbrev KPd : K := KT [] [] [2] [2] [(2, 7)]
def h26 : PS := run KP [] (h14p ++ [.pin 2])

/-- **H26** (E; B6, A8; N3; covered pass 3). `free` of a pinned storage: rejected; `unpin` without
`ExternalDone`: rejected. Expected: reject, reject; obtained: the same. Twins: `free` without the pin
accepted; with `ExternalDone`, `unpin` then `free` accepted. -/
theorem H26 : PReach KP [] h26 ∧ FreeStep KP 2 7 h26.s .reject ∧ UnpinStep KP 2 h26.s .reject ∧
    PReach KP [] (run KP [] (h14p ++ [.free 2 7])) ∧
    PReach KPd [] (run KPd [] (h14p ++ [.pin 2, .unpin 2, .free 2 7])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide),
    run_reach (by decide) (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-! ## F. Calls -/

def h27a : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .write 0 [0], .derive 0 0 .modify, .enter [1] [],
  .release 1]
def h27at : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .write 0 [0], .derive 0 0 .modify, .enter [1] []]

/-- **H27a** (F; A2, G1; N3; covered pass 7). The callee releases its `Modify` parameter, then tries
to write the caller's local by another path, with no blocking authority in between: rejected for
every authority. Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twin: the write through the parameter, before
its release, is accepted. -/
theorem H27a : PReach K0 [] h27a ∧ (∀ a, Write3Step a [0] h27a.s .reject) ∧ PReach K0 [] h27at ∧
    Write3Step 1 [0] h27at.s (.ok (write3Eff h27at.s [0])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), write_rejected (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H27b: the run of the pass-7 witness `ub` (`call_protects_params_safe_fails_unblock`). -/
def h27b : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0),
  lf, (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)], .derive 1 3 .modify, .derive 0 0 .modify,
  .derive 4 1 .modify, .derive 4 2 .modify, .derive 2 4 .modify, .store 5 5, .store 6 6,
  .enter [3, 4, 7] [], .release 3, .release 5, .release 6]

/-- **H27b** (F; J2; class spec 3; covered pass 7). The same attempt after releasing the authorities
that blocked the origin: the write of the leaf 3 of the parameter's footprint through its origin 1
is accepted by the kernel. Expected: `ok` in the kernel, strong protection deferred to spec 3;
obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H27b : PReach K0 [] h27b ∧ Write3Step 1 [3] h27b.s (.ok (write3Eff h27b.s [3])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

def h27c1 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .derive 0 0 .modify, .derive 1 0 .modify]
def h27c2 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf],
  .derive 1 1 .modify, .derive 2 2 .modify]

/-- **H27c** (F; G1; N3; covered pass 7, `cp0`, `co0`). Passing `&mut x` and a derivation of `x`;
passing `&mut v` and an access to the storage owned by `v`: both calls rejected at `enterFrame`
(G1). Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twins: each call with the first parameter alone,
accepted. -/
theorem H27c : PReach K0 [] h27c1 ∧ EnterStep [1, 2] [] h27c1.s .reject ∧
    EnterStep [1] [] h27c1.s (.ok (enterEff h27c1.s [1] [])) ∧
    PReach K0 [] h27c2 ∧ EnterStep [3, 4] [] h27c2.s .reject ∧
    EnterStep [3] [] h27c2.s (.ok (enterEff h27c2.s [3] [])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide),
    run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- **H28** (F; MM-03.1.3; N3). `Observe` and `Modify` parameters on two disjoint parts of a
structure: the call is accepted. Expected: `ok`; obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H28 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 1 .observe, .derive 0 2 .modify,
    .enter [1, 2] []]) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- H29: frame 1, `V` (0) and `X` (1) written; 2, `Observe` on `X`, stored into `V`. -/
def h29p : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1], .derive 1 1 .observe,
  .store 2 0]
def h29 : PS := run K0 [] (h29p ++ [.derive 0 0 .observe, .enter [3] []])

/-- **H29** (F; C4; N3; covered pass 4, `rq1`). The callee, with an `Observe` parameter on `V`,
releases the authority held by `V`: rejected (`HolderRight`). Expected: reject; obtained: reject.
Twin with a `Modify` parameter: accepted. -/
theorem H29 : PReach K0 [] h29 ∧ ReleaseStep 2 h29.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (h29p ++ [.derive 0 0 .modify, .enter [3] [], .release 2])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- H29b: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, value 2; storage 3 with the leaf 4; the block 4 on
`[4]` issued to 2; 5, `Modify` from the block; 6, `Observe` on the arena value; the call. -/
def h29bo : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1], .alloc 1 0 [lf, (some 3, none, 0)],
  .write 0 [0], .newArena 3 3, .issue 0 0 [4] 2, .derive 4 4 .modify, .derive 0 0 .observe,
  .enter [6, 5] []]

/-- **H29b** (F; G1; Lib; covered pass 7). The arena value passed `Observe` and a `Modify` parameter
derived from a block held by a value of the caller: the call is accepted. Expected: `ok`;
obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H29b : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] h29bo) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- **H44** (G; §4, A10; Lib). Frame 1: arena value 0, allocator 1, pool value 2, handle leaves 3 and
4; storage 5 owned by 0, with the place 6 holding the nodes 7 (fields 8, 9) and 10 (fields 11, 12);
arena on 5; the block on the footprint of 6 issued to the pool value; pool on 6 with that block as
`internal`. Each node resolved in turn, its link written (the handle of the other node), then
unresolved; `endUse` of the pool value; `reset` of the arena, without reading the links. Expected:
`ok`; obtained: `ok` at each step. -/
theorem H44 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] h44o) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-! ## H. Abusive rejections (the model must accept) -/

/-- H35: frame 1, structure 0 with the columns 1 and 2, split and written. -/
def h35o : List Op := [.enter [] S2, .split 0 [[1], [2]], .write 1 [1], .write 2 [2]]

/-- **H35** (H; MM-03.1.3; N3; covered jalon 1, case 15). SoA: two columns written after `split`.
Expected: `ok`; obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H35 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] h35o) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- H36: a local written, ended, written again and read. -/
def h36o : List Op := [.enter [] [lf], .write 0 [0], .endUse 0, .write 0 [0], .read 0 [0]]

/-- **H36** (H; C8; N3; covered pass 4). A local ended by `endUse`, then written again and read.
Expected: `ok`; obtained: `ok`. -/
theorem H36 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] h36o) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- H37: frame 1, result 0, allocator 1 written; it passes 2 (`Modify` on 0) and 3 (`Modify` on 1);
the callee allocates the storage 3 (leaf 4) owned by its arena value 2, of root 5, creates the arena,
transfers its value to the result and exits. -/

/-! ## I. Progress (`NoLock`, material §5) -/

/-- Pass-7 arena `fa`: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, values 2 and 3; storage 4 with the nodes
5 and 6; blocks 5 on `[5]` to 2 and 6 on `[6]` to 3. -/
def fao : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1],

/-- H48: 7, `Modify` on B from its block, stored into A; 8, `Modify` on A from its block. -/
def h48o : List Op := fao ++ [.derive 6 6 .modify, .store 7 5, .derive 5 5 .modify]
def h48 : PS := run K0 [] h48o
def h48t : PS := run K0 [] (fao ++ [.derive 6 6 .modify, .derive 5 5 .modify])

/-- **H48** (I; G2; N3; covered pass 7, `progress_cycle_whole_nodes`). A cycle of two authorities on
whole nodes by direct `store`: the closing `store` is rejected by its arrival clause. Expected:
reject; obtained: reject. Twin without the first `store`: accepted. -/
theorem H48 : PReach K0 [] h48 ∧ StoreStep 8 6 h48.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] h48t ∧
    StoreStep 8 6 h48t.s (.ok (storeEff h48t.s 8 6)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H49: the cycle of H48 closed with the helper 9, then released (pass-7 `f7a_cycle_by_release`). -/

def h49 : PS := run K0 [] h49o

/-- **H49** (I; §5; N3; covered pass 7). The same cycle, closed through a helper authority then its
`release`: accepted; the authorities 7 and 8 are then exercisable at no mode and `reset` is
rejected. Expected: to arbitrate (§5); obtained: `ok`, with a residual blocking. -/
theorem H49 : PReach K0 [] h49 ∧ ¬ h49.s.ExercisableAt 7 .observe ∧
    ¬ h49.s.ExercisableAt 8 .observe ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 h49.s .reject :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), by decide, by decide, .reject (by decide)⟩

/-- H50, `transfer`: frame 1, structure 0 with the field 1, structure 2 with the field 3; 2,
`Modify` on 3, stored into 1; 0 transferred into 2 (pass-7 `held_unexercisable_by_transfer`). -/
def h50ao : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, (some 0, none, 0), lf, (some 2, none, 0)],
  .derive 1 3 .modify, .store 2 1, .transfer 0 2]
def h50a : PS := run K0 [] h50ao
/-- H50, `issue`: the block on the node 5 issued to the node 5 itself (pass-7
`held_unexercisable_by_issue`). -/
def h50bo : List Op := fao.take 5 ++ [.issue 0 0 [5] 5]
def h50b : PS := run K0 [] h50bo

/-- **H50** (I; §5; N3, Lib; covered pass 7). An authority transferred or issued into the place it
covers: accepted, and then exercisable at no mode. Expected: to arbitrate (§5); obtained: `ok`,
with a residual blocking. -/
theorem H50 : PReach K0 [] h50a ∧ ¬ h50a.s.ExercisableAt 2 .observe ∧
    PReach K0 [] h50b ∧ ¬ h50b.s.ExercisableAt 5 .observe :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), by decide, run_reach (by decide) (by decide), by decide⟩

/-- H51: frame 1, allocator 0, `v` (1) written; storage 2 with the element 3, owned by `v`, of root 2
held by `v`; the helper 3, `Modify` on the storage; 4, `Observe` on `v`, stored into the element 3;
the helper released. -/
def h51o : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, (some 2, none, 0)], .derive 2 2 .modify, .derive 1 1 .observe, .store 4 3,
  .release 3]
def h51 : PS := run K0 [] h51o
/-- H51 without the helper: 3, `Observe` on `v`. -/
def h51n : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, (some 2, none, 0)], .derive 1 1 .observe]

/-- **H51** (I; §5; N3). An element of a storage owned by `v` holds a view on `v`. The direct `store`
is rejected: the view already takes away the frame's `Modify` on `v`, hence on the storage `v` owns

storage, then its `release`, the configuration is reached. Then `v` can be neither written, ended by `endUse`, nor relieved of the view (`release`
rejected), while the view stays exercisable at `Observe`; the exit of the frame releases it.
Expected: to arbitrate (§5); obtained: `ok`, with a residual blocking until the exit. -/

    Write3Step 1 [1] h51.s .reject ∧ ReleaseStep 4 h51.s .reject ∧ EndUseStep K0 1 h51.s .reject ∧

  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide), .reject (by decide), by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

/-! ## Usage scenarios (material §5b) -/

value, with the nodes 5 (fields `data` 6, `parent` 7, `child` 8) and 9 (10, 11, 12); pool on 4. The

`resolve Modify`, writes, `unresolve`; then a resolution of the first node to write its data; then
`freeSlot` of the second, still designated by the child field of the first. -/
def w1o : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, (some 4, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0), (some 5, none, 0),

  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩ .modify, .write 8 [10, 11], .unresolve 7,
  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify, .write 10 [6], .unresolve 9,
  .freeSlot 0 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩]

def plW : Pool := ⟨0, 4, 4, [⟨5, 0, true⟩, ⟨9, 1, false⟩]⟩

/-- **W1** (§5b, scene graph; Lib). Every step `ok`; `resolve` of the stale handle of the freed
node: `fail`; `freeSlot` during an active resolution: reject. Expected: the same; obtained: the

    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (w1o ++ [.resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify, .unresolve 11,
      .freeSlot 0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), by decide,
    .fail (pl := plW) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .borrowed (pl := plW) (sl := ⟨5, 0, true⟩) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- W2: frame 1, allocator 0, owners 1 and 2 of two archetypes, entity pool value 3, handle leaves
4, 5, 6. Archetype 7 (columns 8 with 9, 10 and 11 with 12, 13) owned by 1; archetype 14 (columns

Modify` of three distinct entities; system A, done, releases its column authority 10. -/
def w2o : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .write 2 [2], .write 3 [3],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, (some 7, none, 0), (some 8, none, 0), (some 8, none, 0), (some 7, none, 0),

  .alloc 0 2 [lf, (some 14, none, 0), (some 15, none, 0), (some 15, none, 0), (some 14, none, 0),

def w2a : PS := run K0 [] (w2o ++ [.release 12])

    run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .ok (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- W3, literal reading: frame 1, arena value 0, allocator 1, block values 2, 3, 4, structure 5

fields 3, 4, 5; the views 7, 8, 9 derived from them and stored into the fields 6, 7, 8. -/
def w3vo : List Op := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, (some 2, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0),

theorem W3 : PReach K0 [] w3 ∧ ResetAtStep K0 0 0 w3.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] w3e ∧
    ResetAtStep K0 0 0 w3e.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] (w3o ++ [.endUse 5, .endUse 2, .endUse 3, .endUse 4, .reset 0 0,

/-! ## Observations on the contract of the pool (report, (g))

Reached runs that bear on the reading of material §4, kept as witnesses. -/

/-- The prefix of H44: a pool on an arena block, both entries allocated, nothing resolved, nothing

précondition d'`endUse` échoue"): `internal` itself is an active derived authority on the entry, held

    .endUse (pl := ⟨0, 6, 6, [⟨7, 0, true⟩, ⟨10, 0, true⟩]⟩) (sl := ⟨7, 0, true⟩) (by decide)
      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), by decide, by decide⟩

      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), by decide⟩

frees its entry 0 and allocates it again; the handle of pool 1 on the same place still resolves. -/

`Uninit`"): a storage written before `newPool` gives a live entry whose content is `Init`. -/
theorem pool_allocSlot_content_init : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf],
      .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf, (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)],

      .allocSlot 0 0 2]).s.I 5 = .init :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), by decide⟩

/-! ## J. Out of kernel (material §1 J): the one expressible expansion -/

/-- Contracts with the place 3 deallocable by the authority 7. -/
abbrev KJ : K := KT [] [] [] [3] [(3, 7)]

/-- H42 (`defer free(x)` then `transfer(x)` before an exit) has no `defer` in the kernel; its

theorem J_H42_expansion : PReach KJ [] (run KJ [] [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0],
    .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [lf], .transfer 1 2, .free 3 7]) :=

# Report — kernel-defs

Scope: definitions of the access kernel, spec v0 Parts IV–XIII and XV–XVI (§21–§75, §79–§81).
Namespace `Ern.MemoryModel.Access`. Nothing committed; `specs/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`,
`formal/DESIGN.md`, `formal/Ern.lean` untouched (the `Ern.*` glob builds the new modules).
Note: `formal/Ern/.gitkeep` shows as deleted in `git status`; this pass did not touch it.

## Files written

| File | Lines | def | theorem | structure | inductive | abbrev | instance | example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `formal/Ern/MemoryModel/Access/Basic.lean` | 842 | 39 | 35 | 5 | 9 | 2 | 17 | 0 |
| `formal/Ern/MemoryModel/Access/Ops.lean` | 986 | 71 | 0 | 16 | 2 | 0 | 38 | 0 |
| `formal/Ern/MemoryModel/Access/Invariants.lean` | 252 | 23 (6 in `Examples`) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 8 (6 in `Examples`) | 20 |

Readings: `scratchpad/ref/readings/kernel-defs.md`. Scratch witnesses (not in the repo):
`scratchpad/kd/Readings.lean`.

## Status

- `lake build Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Invariants` (builds all three): success, no warnings.
- `axcheck.sh` on the three modules: empty lists (Basic 488 constants, Ops 399, Invariants 71). No
  `Classical.choice`.
- Forbidden-token grep (AGENTS.md) prints nothing; no `noncomputable`, no `set_option`.
- Every declaration has a docstring citing its clause (checked by script); every precondition field
  cites §N.k.
- Theorems are only the decision-procedure lemmas: `kiter_*`, `kstab_*`, `countP_*`,
  `usable_iff`, `pframe_iff`, `ownedIn_iff`, `exercisableAt_iff`, `anchorOrder_iff`,
  `anchorOrderHeld_iff` and their helpers. No preservation proof. Nothing unproven.
- Every operation precondition is a structure with a `Decidable` instance (via `decidable_of_iff`
  on the field conjunction), bounded by `List.range`. `decide` evaluates them: 20 examples in
  `Invariants.lean` (`Examples`), one accepting state per operation, a few rejections, and the
  §63.8 witness E-63.8 (all other transfer clauses hold, §63.8 alone rejects). Each runs in well
  under a second.

## Spec problems (details and witnesses in the readings)

1. **SP-A1 (blocking §57 for transfer).** With the policy's `TransferPre` (no draft
   `Usable dst`-after clause), `transfer` accepts an ownership cycle: witness W1, decided. The
   resulting state breaks §49.8 and `NoDangling`. `transfer_preserves` cannot be proven for these
   definitions.
2. **SP-A2** §71.2 vs §36 (provider `writeShared` branch), kept as §71.2 says.
3. **SP-A3** §69.2/§70.3 without the ancestor disjunct leave an active authority with an inactive
   origin (W2, decided); I2 holds only under "valid origin = exists".
4. **SP-A4** domain of `StaticPinnedBottom`.
5. **SP-A5** clauses with no checkable content, omitted: §60.1c, §60.4b, §62.5, §63.6
   non-escape, §64.2b, §66.3b, §67.3b, §72.2a, §73.2a, §74 "pinning obligations".

## Readings not fixed by the policy (summary; full table in the readings file)

§60.3 as I1 on the new pair; §62.3 every active descendant blocks (W4); §63.6 `movedDeps` with
pre-state usability; §63.6 non-escape omitted; §64 draft `NoEscape` dropped (implied by §64.3);
§67.2 as "no other effective mode"; §68.2 `Observe`; §69.2 qualifier dropped (W3: a callee cannot
`endUse` through its `Modify` parameter); §69.3 after-effect anchors; §70.3 ancestor disjunct
dropped by analogy with the policy's §69 decision; §70 effect and §70.3c on the whole released
unit (`FreedPlace`); §71.2 metadata = all provider leaves; §71.3 `Usable owner`; provider `Init`
write dropped; §72.1 `F ≠ []`; §73.1 `F.tail ≠ []`; §44 frame of effective anchor = holder frame;
§51 valid origin = existing; `I4` stated on regions.

theorem getElem?_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :

/-! ## Guarded transitions (§58) -/

/-- A guarded transition has one outcome (§58). -/
theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- The `ok` outcome of a guarded transition: the preconditions hold and the state is the effect
(§58). -/
theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩

/-- The `reject` outcome of a guarded transition: the preconditions fail (§58). -/
theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; assumption, fun h => .reject h⟩

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Cases 2 and 4 of §43: a present effective mode is the own mode when no active descendant
covers the leaf, `Observe` when only `Observe` descendants do. -/
theorem effOf_cases {m m' : Mode} {ds : List Mode} (h : effOf m ds = some m') :
    (ds = [] ∧ m' = m) ∨ (ds ≠ [] ∧ Mode.modify ∉ ds ∧ m' = .observe) := by
  unfold effOf at h
  by_cases h0 : ds = []
  · simp [h0] at h; exact .inl ⟨h0, h.symm⟩
